C1401.title: Beanstalk DAO Governance Attack Incident
C1401.summary: On April 17, 2022, the Beanstalk protocol suffered a governance attack. The attacker used a flash loan to obtain temporary voting power, pushed a previously submitted malicious proposal past the emergency execution threshold, and transferred assets out of the protocol. Security analyses estimated protocol losses at about $181 million, while the attacker obtained roughly $80 million in realizable assets. The incident exposed the risk of governance systems without an execution delay.

references.title: Hack Analysis: Beanstalk Governance Attack, April 2022
